ops.body:
Implementation lanes launched as each mapped contract settled (native Claude Code Workflows, coordinator Opus 5.5):
1) Orca Run wf_dabe0930-23d (replaces wf_1c30c2ff-2b1, stopped before any file changes: its lanes had a contract placeholder). Contract: cc-notes doc a8da144 (reconciles the host and client mappings plus the cc-sync CLI JSON; the crossMachineRecovery prefix avoids a clash with existing Orca "recovery" concepts; capabilities cross-machine-recovery.workspace.v1 / cross-machine-recovery.presentation.v1; `orca recovery` CLI is local-only; picker execs the provider CLI over desktop-only IPC). Stages: foundation in /Users/yasyf/.claude/worktrees/orca/xmr (branch cc-sync/cross-machine-recovery, base upstream a85057ef48), then parallel lanes xmr-host-export / xmr-host-import / xmr-presentation / xmr-picker (worktrees /Users/yasyf/.claude/worktrees/orca/<lane>), then integration, astra finder review with an opus fix pass, then hidden rendered QA (ORCA_BACKGROUND_LAUNCH=1). Branches push to the yasyf/orca fork only.
2) reposync Run wf_b9d6f927-ff6. Contract: cc-notes doc f413e56 = mapped contract plus binding amendments from the root LFS/omission review. LFS is first-class: raw bytes for real edits, a self-computed pointer compare for stat-dirty files, and a named MissingLFSError. Shipped objects: staged pointers + objects, and LFS objects referenced by unpublished commits; base assets are fetched under policy. No fixed size omissions: the 1 GiB/200k-entry budgets are resumable PartialError progress and never yield a Snapshot. Only submodule, nested-repo and special-file omissions remain; each sets Complete=false and is never Ready. No heuristic exclusions, so tracked generated edits are WIP. Worktrees: foundation /Users/yasyf/.claude/worktrees/reposync/worktree-snapshot (cc-sync/worktree-snapshot), capture /Users/yasyf/.claude/worktrees/reposync/capture (cc-sync/worktree-capture), verify-restore /Users/yasyf/.claude/worktrees/reposync/verify-restore (cc-sync/worktree-restore).
Pending: synckit artifacts/delivery-supersede plus Claude store/cc-sync lanes launch next from the core/transport/claude mappings. The root per-chunk receiver-policy and artifact-root digest-binding requirements go into the synckit contract.
